say:0:1410319101:3.text: Argh! This is the worst luck! The temple was nearly finished, and then we got pulled down here at the last minute...
say:0:1410319101:3.source_cn: 太倒霉了！神殿都快完工了，结果又被临时抽调来这里……

say:1:1410319102:0.text: And now I have to deal with this smug, puffed-up priest! The only good thing about today was seeing you, Aunt Zanie!
say:1:1410319102:0.source_cn: 还遇到一个不讲理的艾塞勒祭司！唯一的好事就是见到了你，...

say:2:1410319103:0.text: ... Finn, you guys are really building the temple, huh?

say:3:1410319104:0.text: Heh, you slipped up! You called me Finn, which means you DO remember me!
say:3:1410319104:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，祖娅姑姑，你承认了！

say:4:1410319105:0.text: Ugh, fine, you got me. Now spill, tell me about the temple!
say:4:1410319105:0.source_cn: 别废话，跟我讲讲神殿的事！

say:5:1410319106:0.text: ... Aunt, let's be clear—I know you're against it. But Eldric's leading the charge, and he's dead set on finishing it.
say:5:1410319106:0.source_cn: ……姑姑，先声明啊，我知道你反对建神殿。但现在是弗林领...

say:6:1410319107:0.text: It's almost done. You should go see it sometime. It's pretty impressive!
say:6:1410319107:0.source_cn: 目前建得差不多了，你要是有机会记得去看看！还挺壮观的！

say:7:1410319108:0.text: That said, you leaving the village was probably the right move. Eldric's become more and more... well, never mind that!
say:7:1410319108:0.source_cn: 虽说如此，但你离开村子反而是对的。弗林这些年变得越来越...

say:8:1410319109:0.text: Who's this with you? They're not Essail, are they?
say:8:1410319109:0.source_cn: 你旁边的这位是？应该不是艾塞勒吧？

choice_prompt:9:1410319109.text: Who's this with you? They're not Essail, are they?
choice_prompt:9:1410319109.source_cn: 你旁边的这位是？应该不是艾塞勒吧？

say:10:1410319110:0.text: An envoy? What in Helthor's name is an envoy doing underground?! Eldric never mentioned anything about this...
say:10:1410319110:0.source_cn: 特使？你怎么来了地下？！弗林他也没提……
say:10:1410319110:0.male: An envoy? What in Helthor's name is an envoy doing underground?! Eldric never mentioned anything about this...
say:10:1410319110:0.female: An envoy? What in Helthor's name is an envoy doing underground?! Eldric never mentioned anything about this...

say:11:1410319111:0.text: Finn, listen. He's got an important role. Don't go blabbing to Eldric just yet, alright?
say:11:1410319111:0.male: Finn, listen. He's got an important role. Don't go blabbing to Eldric just yet, alright?
say:11:1410319111:0.female: Finn, listen. She's got an important role. Don't go blabbing to Eldric just yet, alright?

say:12:1410319112:0.text: Well, if you say so. I'll keep quiet. It's been way too long since we last saw each other! Hey, I've got some technical questions for you!
say:12:1410319112:0.source_cn: 好，我相信你的判断。咱们真的太久没见了！我有机械方面的...

say:13:1410319113:0.text: You've grown up, huh? Actually getting into research now.
say:13:1410319113:0.source_cn: 是什么？你小子长进了，也知道搞研究了！

say:14:1410319114:0.text: Haha! Yes, I designed an automatic loader, but the drive shaft's got an issue...
say:14:1410319114:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，就是我设计了一种自动装卸机，但传动轴的设计还有些...

say:15:1410319115:0.text: Ha, rookie mistake! Did you bring the blueprints? Lemme see. We'll figure it out together!
say:15:1410319115:0.source_cn: 带图纸了吗？给我看看，我们一起研究一下！

say:18:1410319116:0.text: Magister, while Zanie's catching up with her... nephew, let's step aside for a second.
say:18:1410319116:0.source_cn: 主人……趁祖娅和那个矮人在叙旧，我们到边上去聊一聊吧。
say:18:1410319116:0.male: Magister, while Zanie's catching up with her... nephew, let's step aside for a second.
say:18:1410319116:0.female: Magister, while Zanie's catching up with her... nephew, let's step aside for a second.
